ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is the Nyquist curve of the open-loop transfer function G(s), with the horizontal axis as Re(s) and the vertical axis as Im(s). The point -1 is marked on the negative direction of the real axis. The curve contains a relatively large outer loop and two smaller loops close to the negative real axis, and the arrows give the direction of travel of the curve. When observing the loops near the point -1, it is necessary to calculate the net number of encirclements of the point -1 according to the arrow direction; the directions of the relevant loops visible in the figure cancel each other, so the net encirclement number of the point -1 is N=0. Then reason: The problem gives that G(s) has no poles in the right-half s plane, so the number of open-loop right-half-plane poles is P=0. For a unity negative feedback system, the closed-loop characteristic equation is 1+G(s)=0; by the Nyquist criterion, the number of roots of the closed-loop characteristic equation in the right half-plane is Z=P+N. Substituting P=0 and N=0 gives Z=0. Therefore the number of roots of the system characteristic equation in the right-half s plane is 0.

method.method_draft: First read the Nyquist plot and locate the -1 point on the real axis. Count the net encirclements of -1, taking arrow directions into account rather than merely checking whether -1 lies inside a loop. The visible loops around -1 cancel in orientation, giving zero net encirclement. From the text, use that G(s) has no right-half-plane poles, so P=0. Apply Nyquist criterion for unity negative feedback: the number of RHP roots of the characteristic equation equals Z=P+N=0+0=0.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是开环传递函数 G(s) 的 Nyquist 曲线，横轴为 Re(s)，纵轴为 Im(s)。实轴负方向上标出了 -1 点。曲线包含一个较大的外环以及靠近负实轴的两个较小回环，箭头给出了曲线的走向。观察 -1 点附近的回环时，需要按箭头方向计算对 -1 点的净环绕次数；图中可见的相关回环方向相互抵消，因此对 -1 点的净环绕数为 N=0。

再推理：题目给出 G(s) 在右半 s 平面没有极点，因此开环右半平面极点数 P=0。对单位负反馈系统，闭环特征方程为 1+G(s)=0；由 Nyquist 判据，闭环特征方程在右半平面的根数为 Z=P+N。代入 P=0、N=0，得到 Z=0。因此系统特征方程在右半 s 平面的根数为 0。
